authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: EED item 4 maps to DXF group 1004 and contains a one-byte length followed by that many bytes.

construction: LibreDWG 0.14 generates locally authored R13/R14 controls with a 128-byte EED item, remapped graph and one 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback verifies source values and graph. Generated drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The shared legacy dictionary observer matches the physical length and every payload byte to the typed binary value and requires the token span to end exactly.
The ASan source control checks every source bit, all frame truncations, an altered model byte and corrected retry.

Group, NOD and MLINESTYLE owner profiles pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output with mutation refusal, destination preservation and corrected retry. An out-of-profile 1005 handle retains its partial route and references the remapped LINE.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback verifies the complete payload as 127-byte and 1-byte chunks and the GROUP-to-LINE graph for both output encodings, all three locations and both source versions.
limits: R13 output remains explicit partial; MLINESTYLE source semantics, native cloning and general DWG/DXF support remain unqualified.
The independent generated witness exercises 128 bytes; it does not qualify application-specific binary meanings or unobserved EED codes.
